text:
Situation: Corvale Lakeside holds 7 days of warfarin sodium (18 units at 2.6 per day). Corvale East holds 26 days (272 units at 10.5 per day). Corvale General holds two lots totaling 18.9 and 24.9 days. FDA does not list warfarin sodium on its shortage list as of 2026-10-21.

Why (FDA record): FDA inspection 590126 of Bryant Ranch PrePack (FEI 1000519407) ended 2009-06-11 and was classified OAI, with classification known 2009-09-09. That plant appears on the label for NDC 71335063706 used at Corvale General. The same plant received a Warning Letter on 2010-04-08 and subsequent VAI inspections through 2026-07-16.

Our position: Lakeside is below the two-week target. East and General can each spare stock while retaining at least two weeks. No FDA shortage listing exists to trigger allocation programs.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 19 units from Corvale East to Corvale Lakeside — needs pharmacy director (transfer request).
2. Transfer 19 units from Corvale General to Corvale Lakeside — needs pharmacy director (transfer request).
3. Buy from American Health Packaging — needs buyer (plant last inspected VAI 2026-06-15).
4. Buy from A-S Medication Solutions — needs buyer.
5. Buy from Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC — needs buyer.

Not recommended: No action.
